text:
nina: heads up — deploybot auto-halted the release window for canary. Orchestrator OOMs on ci-orch-02 and a flakey e2e (testdog:scenario-7) failing 3/3 runs. Holding promotion.
kevin: thanks. any logs?
maria: paste from the runner: 
```
ERROR: runtime: out of memory
module: orchestrator/scheduler.go:217
stack: goroutine 482 [running]:
````
alex: looks like the orchestration queue starved, tasks piled up then OOM'd. Did we recently bump parallelism on postsubmit?
nina: yes — postsubmit concurrency was increased yesterday for a perf job, might've impacted shared runners.
sre-oncall: i'm looking at runner pool. ci-orch-02 and 03 hit oom and eviction churn. scaling didn't kick because autoscaler hit API rate limit from artifact uploads.
maria: artifact uploads? which artifact size?
sre-oncall: large wheel build. upload retries spiked, triggered backpressure in the deploy scheduler.
deploy-bot: automated note: canary promotion paused at step=promote-to-staging; last-green-image=docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-12-9f2b3c. To continue manually run: `deploybot promote --to-image 9f2b3c --force --reason "manual-pin-due-to-ci-oom"`
jessica: can we pin to last-green image and continue? we have customers depending on release window.
kevin: i'd prefer pin + postmortem. quick plan: 1) pin to last-green (manual promote via deploybot). 2) revert concurrency bump on postsubmit. 3) increase runner ephemeral quota + add retry jitter for artifact uploads.
nina: agree. who can run the manual promote?
maria: I can run it after we confirm registry integrity. I'll validate the image hash and do promote in 10m.
sre-oncall: i'll temporarily scale runners + throttle the perf job. Also opening a ticket for autoscaler API quota bump.
alex: add a note to release notes: "manual promotion due to CI orchestrator OOM; build pinned to last-green image 9f2b3c; follow-up: runner autoscaler and artifact retry hardening."
jessica: i'll update the release page and message PMs. Also scheduling a 30-min postmortem later today.
maria: starting promote now — running `deploybot promote --to-image 9f2b3c --reason \"pin-for-release-window\"`
deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary rollout to staging at 10%. watching health checks.
kevin: monitor e2e and smoke. if testdog fails again we rollback to previous tag and pause release until postmortem.
sre-oncall: runners scaling up, throttled perf job. uploads stabilized.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded. canary at 100% in staging. promotion skipped for prod (manual approval required).
jessica: thanks team. holding prod cut until postmortem and we confirm CI stability.
nina: closing the slack thread for now — recorded decision: manual pin to last-green image, postpone prod cut, postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
